_comment: Camera rig profile template + quality-gate defaults. Owned by ML role. No camera rig exists yet (task C8 is blocked on hardware), so this is a TEMPLATE: the quality thresholds below mirror backend/quality/validity.py (QualityPolicy) exactly and carry thresholds_calibrated=false. Final plan section 7.2 forbids presenting one universal blur cutoff as calibrated; per-rig calibration from accepted/rejected examples is task C11 and cannot happen until a camera exists. Fill the rig_* fields from real hardware, then re-derive and re-validate.

rig._mounting_note: Mounting height, pitch and standoff above the road plane. Required before a road-plane fit and live calibration (task C8).

quality_policy._note: The provisional sharpness floor (10.0) is deliberately LOW because the only real measurement available - the CRKWH100 audit (Laplacian variance 51 min / 435 median / 2721 max) - shows a high default would reject real pavement before per-rig calibration exists. Do not raise it without labelled accepted/rejected examples.

scale._note: scale_source vocabulary: source_calibrated | rig_calibrated | reference_measured | unscaled. A rig becomes rig_calibrated only after intrinsics + a road-plane fit are validated on held-out distances (task C8).

grade._note: Inclination is a separate formal requirement (backend/geometry/grade.py). It is NOT part of surface scoring. Phone pitch and Google elevation are refused as grade truth (task G4). See configs/scoring/ for the surface score; grade stays independent.
